name: MenuBase
root: none (context only); the menu is a div with role menu in the theme's portal container

keys.effect: opens the menu and focuses its first enabled item
closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
opens the menu and focuses its last enabled item
opens the menu and focuses its first enabled item; on an item, runs it and closes the menu
focuses the first enabled item; End the last; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move between enabled items and wrap

focus.initial: opening moves focus to the first enabled item (the last with ArrowUp)
focus.movement: roving between enabled items: ArrowDown, ArrowUp (wrapping), Home, End, type-ahead on the items' text, and the moving pointer
focus.restoration: running an item, Escape, and Tab close the menu and return focus to the trigger; a press outside closes it without moving focus

accessibleName: the menu is named by its trigger (aria-labelledby); a group by its Label; an item by its text
